name: kimai-timer
title: Kimai Timer
description: Track time in Kimai without leaving Raycast: start/stop timers, browse and edit timesheets, and see weekly totals.
author: mvoehringer

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Kimai URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Kimai instance. A trailing /api is stripped automatically.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Create one in Kimai under User → API Access.

commands.name: menubar-timer
commands.title: Running Timer
commands.subtitle: Kimai
commands.description: Show the running timer in the menu bar, pause or stop it, and continue a recent task.

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.subtitle: Kimai
commands.description: Start a new timer for a project and activity.

commands.name: timesheets
commands.title: Timesheets
commands.subtitle: Kimai
commands.description: Browse, edit, restart and delete your time entries.

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Browse Projects
commands.subtitle: Kimai
commands.description: Browse customers, projects and activities and start a timer from them.

commands.name: report
commands.title: Time Report
commands.subtitle: Kimai
commands.description: Totals per project for today, this week and this month.
